name: Torremayor (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of red, white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Torremayor (a tower, a cross of Saint James and a chequy field).
history: Municipal flag of Torremayor; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Torremayor arms — tower, cross of Saint James and chequy
